# Test fixtures

- `Mn3Sn.mcif` — noncollinear antiferromagnet Mn3Sn (inverse triangular spin
  structure), MagCIF exported from the Bilbao Crystallographic Server
  (MAGNDATA), atomic positions ICSD 643730. Magnetic structure from
  P.J. Brown, V. Nunez, F. Tasset, J.B. Forsyth and P. Radhakrishna,
  J. Phys.: Condens. Matter 2, 9409 (1990), doi:10.1088/0953-8984/2/47/015.
  Used to test the MCIF reader, the magnetic site classification and the
  noncollinear QE settings.
